en.title: 7th SWEET EDGE newsletter is out !
en.summary: - First Renewable Energy Outlook for Switzerland (REO) is out!
en.body:
\- First [Renewable Energy Outlook for Switzerland (REO)](/news/three-strategies-to-boost-renewable-electricity-in-switzerland/) is out!

\- New [study on the potential for agri-PV in Swiss agriculture,](https://digitalcollection.zhaw.ch/handle/11475/29857?utm_source=brevo&utm_campaign=7th%20EDGE%20Quarterly%20Newsletter%20%20-%20English&utm_medium=email)

\- [Second Energy Drinks](/news/second-energy-drinks-events-for-the-general-public/) events for the general public,

\- [Interview from our research partner Isabelle Stadelmann-Steffen](https://www.plattformj.ch/artikel/216937/?utm_source=brevo&utm_campaign=7th%20EDGE%20Quarterly%20Newsletter%20%20-%20English&utm_medium=email) following the referendum decision against the "Mantelerlass”,

\- New [YouTube video](https://youtu.be/IAi7KujbCPU?utm_source=brevo&utm_campaign=7th%20EDGE%20Quarterly%20Newsletter%20%20-%20English&utm_medium=email) explaining in simple words the strategies of the "Renewable Energy Outlook"…

…events, publications…and more!
